senses.gloss: (√חו, cmp. חבב) to unite. Part. pass. אָחוּי united.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 13:15">Num. R. s. 13</cite>, beg. <he>שיהיו אֲחוּיִים אצלו</he> they shall be united with him (around his table).

senses.gloss: to join; to sew together (with fine stitches); cmp. חוּט; חוּד I.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 39">Gen. R. s. 39</cite> beg. <he>אברהם שאֹ׳ את וכ׳</he> Abraham who united all mankind into a brotherhood (by the belief in one God), <he>כזה שהוא מְאָחֶה וכ׳</he> like one who sews &c., v. infra.
Ex. R. s. 40, end.—Esp. to mend, by stitching, the rent of the garment torn in mourning.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 26a:26">Ib. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>לאַחוֹתָן</he> to stitch them together.

senses.gloss: to be joined; to be stitched together.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 13:15">Num. R. s. 13</cite>, beg. (play on <he>אחותי</he> <cite ref="Song of Songs 5:1">Cant. V, 1</cite>) <he>נִתְאָחוּ לי וכ׳</he> they were joined to me (I joined them) in the captivity.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 68:11">Gen. R. s. 68</cite> <he>מִתְאָחוֹת</he>, v. <cite ref="A00172"><he>אֶבֶן</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 26a">M. Kat. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>אין מתאחין</he> must not be stitched together.

senses.gloss: to be joined by grafting, to grow together. Y. Kil. I, 27ᵃ top הן נתא׳ וכ׳ they (the two seeds) combine. Y. Shebi. II, end, 34ᵃ bot. Y. Orl. I, 61ᵃ bot.
